description: This Java source file defines the VerifyPickServices class, which provides several static methods for verifying, completing, and canceling pickup items within a shipment verification process in the OFBiz framework. The methods interact with the VerifyPickSession class and utilize OFBiz utility classes for error handling and type safety.

classes.name: VerifyPickServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for verifying individual and bulk pickup items, completing pickups, and canceling all pickup verification rows.

methods.name: verifySingleItem
methods.description: Verifies or creates a record for a single pickup item based on provided context parameters.

methods.name: verifyBulkItem
methods.description: Processes multiple pickup items selected from a provided map, creating verification rows for each.

methods.name: completeVerifiedPick
methods.description: Completes the pickup verification process for an order and returns the shipment ID.

methods.name: cancelAllRows
methods.description: Cancels all pickup verification rows by clearing the session.
